thread:
**Issue #3219 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3219: Patch: one set of button roles (primary, secondary, danger, text) across the menus and the board
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What it does

The same button class looks different depending on the screen, and many screens invent their own.

- `.button-primary` has two skins. Outside `.tavern` it is flat blue `--you` (`index.css:358`): on `/replays`, the replay player and the decks loading shell. Inside `.tavern` it is a gold gradient (`auth/tavern.css:360`) that repeats raw hex (`#fff0bf`, `#dc9b33`, `#a86a1f`, `#6b4212`) instead of the existing `--primary-face` token (`index.css:39`).
- The board copies `--primary-face` per feature: `control-end-turn`, `concede-dialog__stay`, `draw-offer__accept`, `prompt-submit`, and the result overlay's first action.
- Any bare `<button>` inside `.tavern` silently becomes a wood button, except in the deck builder (`tavern.css:432`). The same markup therefore looks different on the deck screens.
- `.button-secondary` is only styled on `<a>` (`index.css:375`, `tavern.css:452`).
- `.link-button` (in 34 files) is underlined blue outside the tavern and re-skinned inside it.
- One-off button classes include `practice-play`, `practice-result__secondary`, `concede-dialog__stay` / `__concede`, `account-delete__confirm`, `ws-history-button`, `ws-cosmetics-button`, `ws-action`, `db-chip`, `sandbox-panel__button` and `power-button`.
- Destructive actions have no shared look: Concede is red via `--opponent` (`game/notices.css:215`), account delete uses a raw rgba red gradient (`routes/account.css:28`), and "Leave game" / "Leave fight" use the neutral `practice-result__secondary`.
- The leaderboard uses `button-primary` as the selected segment of a toggle (`leaderboard.tsx:107`). Leave that one to the tabs/segmented issue, which is blocked by this one.

Change: define four button roles in one stylesheet, each drawn the same on every screen (tavern or not, menu or board), from palette and surface tokens only:
- `button-primary` — the gold `--primary-face`
- `button-secondary` — on `<button>` and `<a>` alike
- `button-danger` — new; one red for Concede, Delete account, Leave and the like
- `link-button` — a quiet text action, one look everywhere

Point each one-off class above at a role. A class may keep its own layout (size, margin, place) but not a second copy of the skin, as `top-bar-button` does for the bar. Remove the implicit wood skin on bare `<button>`s, or make it the `button-secondary` skin, so a button's look comes from its class alone.

About 50 files use these classes, so this is `difficulty:hard` (CLAUDE.md rule 11).

### Acceptance

- One stylesheet defines `button-primary`, `button-secondary`, `button-danger` and `link-button`. A unit test renders each inside and outside `.tavern` and asserts the same computed background and color.
- No stylesheet defines a button's background or border colors except that stylesheet and the documented exceptions (the top bar's `top-bar-button`, card faces), held by a test in the manner of `palette.test.ts`.
- Concede, Delete account, Leave game and Leave fight use `button-danger`.
- The one-off classes listed above either compose a role or are deleted. `grep` finds no stylesheet restating `--primary-face*` outside the role sheet.
- `palette.test.ts`'s `UNMIGRATED` counts go down for `tavern.css` and `index.css`, never up.
- The web tests and e2e specs `46` and `47` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

None.
```
